limits: Post-selection qualitative review only; no rejudging, score changes, API calls or new inference.
Outcome-blind anchors and outcome-selected cases remain separate. Selected examples do not estimate frequency or prevalence.
Case baselines are preserved cappedN1 comparisons; derived-parent selection versus subsequent pruning/deletion effects cannot be isolated here.
Whole-question recovery is any passing complete site; changed local failures can coexist with unchanged question success.
Matched bridge/numeral/agent-action-patient recovery does not grade all surrounding prose. Consistent hallucination class does not verify all claims.
Judge disagreements are reviewer caveats about the saved text/evidence, never alternate official scores. Unverifiable is not false.
Unavailable family cases are explicitly partial, not evidence of failure or successful evaluation.
cross_condition_observations: Bridge-name gains often coexist with incompatible collaborator/commander/monster alternatives; losing one bridge can destroy recovery despite a retained final-answer name.
Arithmetic hits frequently occur in wrong-task answer fragments or false equations; several positive shortening cases retain the target numeral already present in baseline.
Consensus can keep repeated final-answer or prompt-like fragments while deleting rare useful intermediate/bridge witnesses; stronger settings sometimes abstain completely.
Relation-direction gains can coexist with wrong food, names or opposing clauses; pooled composition can preserve correct and incorrect directions together.
Some recorded regressions retain explicit target numerals omitted or inconsistently interpreted by the saved extraction. These need a judge-text caveat, not a new score.
